Evidence: Kejriwal ne 2047 tak Delhi ko world-class city banane ka plan announce kiya hai, jismein unhone corporate houses se ideas aur participation ki zarurat batayi hai (Source 1). Unhone kaha ki 2047 ka target procrastination nahi hai, aur kuch projects 1-2 saal mein complete honge, jabki kuch 2047 tak chalenge (Source 1). Education Minister Atishi ne bhi students se 2047 ke liye unke ideas share karne ka mauka diya, jisse unhone future India ka vision banane ki baat ki (Source 2). Yeh sab indicate karta hai ki Kejriwal ka 2047 ka vision serious hai, na ki sirf ek empty promise (Source 1).
Justification: Claim kehta hai ki Kejriwal ka 2047 tak kuch nahi hoga, lekin retrieved evidence yeh dikhata hai ki Kejriwal ne 2047 tak Delhi ko world-class city banane ka serious plan banaya hai aur ismein unhone specific timelines aur projects ka zikr kiya hai (Source 1). Iske alawa, students ke ideas ko encourage karna bhi yeh dikhata hai ki unka vision practical hai (Source 2). Isliye, evidence claim ko refute karta hai.
